advisory.name: render_harness_identity
advisory.error: Carried forward from Phase 3.1: no render-harness target exists in plugins/O-MicrotonalSampler/tests/. Phase 3.3 introduces zero new audio code paths (folder load was already complete in Phase 2.2; this phase wires the folder path to the existing GUI surfaces). Coverage substituted by pluginval --strictness 5 + auval (both green).

phaseGateCriteria.criterion: Drag a folder onto the drop zone → identical load to button path; grid populates within Stage 2's typical load time
phaseGateCriteria.note: filesDropped folder-zone + isDirectory branch invokes processorRef.loadSampleFolder(folder) — byte-identical entry point to the button's loadSampleFolderDialog resolution path. sampleMapUpdated push event triggers renderGrid + publishCellLayout. Manual DAW smoke deferred to user.

phaseGateCriteria.criterion: Drag a file (not folder) onto the zone → toast "Drop a folder, not a file"; no load
phaseGateCriteria.note: filesDropped folder-zone + non-directory branch emits the toast event via webView->emitEventIfBrowserIsVisible("toast", msg); processor not invoked. JS toast subscriber renders the message in #toast-region with 3 s auto-dismiss.

phaseGateCriteria.criterion: Drag a folder containing intentionally unparseable filenames → load succeeds for parseable files; skipped files appear in disclosure with reasons
phaseGateCriteria.note: processorRef.loadSampleFolder populates lastSkippedFiles in its async completion (Phase 2.2 implementation, unchanged). snapshotSampleMapJson serializes skippedFiles array per RESEARCH §RQ3-2 schema. JS handleSampleMapSnapshot populates <ul id="issues-list"> with one <li> per entry; <details id="issues-disclosure"> summary reads "Issues (N file(s) skipped)".

phaseGateCriteria.criterion: Toast appears on completion when skippedFiles.length > 0; hides cleanly after 3 s
phaseGateCriteria.note: showToast() arms a 3000 ms setTimeout; CSS .toast.show transition fades opacity + transform; element removed from DOM 300 ms after fade-out begins. Transition tracking via lastSkippedSignature ensures idle re-renders with the same skip set don't re-toast.

phaseGateCriteria.criterion: Drag-hover visual feedback works on macOS (Logic AU + Reaper VST3 + Standalone)
phaseGateCriteria.note: fileDragMove + fileDragExit emit hostFileDragMove({x,y}) / hostFileDragExit() events to JS; JS bindHostDragEvents listener computes hit-test against folder-drop-zone's getBoundingClientRect() and toggles .drag-over class. CSS provides dashed-border + inset gold-tinted box-shadow on hover. Manual DAW visual verification deferred to user.

filesDropped iterates cellLayout (populated by Phase 3.2's reportCellLayout); on (x,y) ∈ cell + .wav/.aif/.aiff ext, invokes processorRef.loadSingleSample(midiNote, velocityLayer, file). Same atomic-store + sampleMapUpdated path as Phase 3.2's per-cell FileChooser.

phaseGateCriteria.criterion: EC3-3 — Folder dropped onto cell → routing hint toast (no implicit load)
phaseGateCriteria.note: filesDropped cell-hit + isDirectory branch emits toast "Drop a single file on a cell, or a folder on the top zone." — disallows the ambiguous gesture and surfaces the discoverable affordance for both modes.
filesDropped falls through both cell loop and folder-zone hit-test → returns without dispatching any processor call or toast.
